title: It's Not Too Late
style: emotional pop rock, 98 BPM, piano and acoustic guitar blend, building from quiet to anthemic, redemption theme, warm encouraging male vocal NZ/AU accent, breath audible, no pitch correction, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
You think the window closed on you
You think the door is sealed
You think the version you could've been
Is buried — not revealed

But the version you could still become
Is standing in the hall
Waiting for you to decide
Whether you'll stand or fall

[CHORUS]
It's not too late — never was
It's not too late — just because
You missed a window doesn't mean
The house burned down
It's not too late — open the door
It's not too late — that's what floors are for
Stand on them
Stand up
It's not too late

[VERSE 2]
The 30-year-old songs are out now
The vault was always full
The recordings were professional
Just waiting for the pull

30 years of raw and real
Released in one day
Not late — perfectly timed
That's the only way

[BRIDGE — spoken]
Late is a word for people
who stopped watching the clock.
You never stopped.
That's the difference.

[FINAL CHORUS]
It's not too late — right now
It's not too late — somehow
Every day you show up
Adds to the account
It's not too late

[OUTRO]
Not too late.
Not too late.
It was always on time.
